data.title: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
data.summary_raw: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.
